name: Natsuki Keiji
source:
He is the second son of Natsuki Construction, a local building contractor, and currently works at his family’s business.
He is one of the few seniors close in age to Miho and Kazuya,
but they had no connection during their school days because he was such a troublemaker.
He has plenty of experience with women.
